name: Anandamide
aliases: AEA, 5,8,11,14-Eicosatetraenoylethanolamide, Anandamide (20.4, N-6), Anandamide(20:4, N-6), Arachidonic acid N-(hydroxyethyl)amide, arachidonoyl ethanolamide, Arachidonylethanolamide, N-(2-Hydroxyethyl)anachidonamide
summary: Anandamide (ANA), also referred to as N-arachidonoylethanolamine (AEA), is a fatty acid neurotransmitter belonging to the fatty acid derivative group known as N-acylethanolamines (NAE). Anandamide takes its name from the Sanskrit word ananda (आनन्द), meaning "joy, bliss, delight," plus amide.

pharmacology.text: Anandamide (ANA), also referred to as N-arachidonoylethanolamine (AEA), is a fatty acid neurotransmitter belonging to the fatty acid derivative group known as N-acylethanolamines (NAE). Anandamide, the first discovered endocannabinoid, engages with the body's endocannabinoid system by binding to the same cannabinoid receptors that THC found in cannabis acts on.

uses.text: According to in vitro research, anandamide effects are mediated primarily by CB1 cannabinoid receptors in the central nervous system, and CB2 cannabinoid receptors in the periphery. The latter appear to be involved in functions of the immune system. Cannabinoid receptors were originally discovered as sensitive to Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (Δ9-THC, commonly called THC), which is the primary psychoactive cannabinoid found in cannabis.

summaryZh: 花生四烯乙醇胺（英語：Anandamide），又名N-花生四烯乙醇胺或AEA，是一種內源性的大麻醇類神經傳導物質。命名取自梵文（和印度半島宗教用語）中的「阿難陀」，意為「喜悅、極樂、欣喜」，以及醯胺。它是由N-花生四烯醯磷脂醯乙醇胺透過多種途徑合成。花生四烯乙醇胺，主要是由脂肪酸醯胺水解酶將其降解成乙醇胺和花生四烯酸。

sideEffects.en: As a substance the body makes itself, it is not taken as a drug and has not been studied that way. Cannabinoid receptor agonists as a class can cause a racing heart, dizziness, dry mouth and anxiety.
sideEffects.zh: 作為身體自行製造的物質，它並不作為藥物服用，也未以那種方式被研究。大麻素受體促效劑作為一類，可能造成心跳急促、頭暈、口乾與焦慮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 作为身体自行制造的物质，它并不作为药物服用，也未以那种方式被研究。大麻素受体促效剂作为一类，可能造成心跳急促、头晕、口干与焦虑。

fact.en: Anandamide was the first endocannabinoid found, identified in 1992 by Raphael Mechoulam's team. Its name comes from ananda, the Sanskrit word for joy or bliss. It is also present in chocolate.
fact.zh: 花生四烯乙醇胺是第一個被發現的內源性大麻素，由 Raphael Mechoulam 的團隊於 1992 年鑑定。它的名稱來自梵文的 ananda，意為喜悅或極樂。巧克力中也含有它。
fact.zhHans: 花生四烯乙醇胺是第一个被发现的内源性大麻素，由 Raphael Mechoulam 的团队于 1992 年鉴定。它的名称来自梵文的 ananda，意为喜悦或极乐。巧克力中也含有它。
